target: Determine whether the stated comparison map is injective under the exact hypotheses recorded in the problem dossier.
scope: Only the finite, torsion-free case in the dossier normalization; no claim is made for omitted coefficients or for novelty.

outcome.generality: Established only in degrees zero and one under the stated finite, torsion-free hypotheses.
outcome.remaining_unproved: The degree-two kernel calculation and an independent check remain open.

limitations: No literature or novelty check was run.

claims.verification: Self-checked only; no ledger promotion is authorized.

artifacts.role: Canonical calculation and exact remaining matrix.

continuation.next_action: Compute the degree-two kernel from the explicit matrix and request an independent check.
